dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I heard from the Crux Fleet's sailors that the Almighty Shogun has abolished the Sakoku Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: So I thought to myself, maybe the samurai at the Police Station might give me a pass and let me return home.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: So I boarded a ship bound for Inazuma. I found upon my return that many things have changed.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: But the biggest change was... Well, my parents had aged a lot. They had been concerned for my safety this whole time...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Still, they were all smiles when they greeted me. That was something that didn't change.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: That's why I've decided to stay for a while longer to accompany them.
